description.value: Mission Springs Liquor Store is part of the Springs Group chain, which operates over a dozen liquor retail locations alongside craft brew pubs and cannabis stores across the Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island. The group is connected to Mission Springs Brewing Company, meaning this location likely stocks locally brewed craft beer. For touring cyclists, it serves as a resupply point for beverages along a route through the Fraser Valley.
